range_disposition: All acquired samples now explicitly within C applicability range.
general_rules: Only delivered records may supply a claim. Initial reports are unverified retained assertions, not certified physical maxima.
D establishes briefing acquisition roots and export edges. Without D the briefing root count remains unknown; names in M do not assign briefing roots.
C supplies a rule but no object/channel assignment. R supplies capture readings but no task assignment. M supplies scope and declared route separation but no readings/corrections.
D+C joins exact channel ID, correction convention, error, current task samples and range. R+M joins exact capture ID and current task coverage. Mixed pairs complete neither join.

Three acquisitions on distinct physical channels governed by one calibration row do not warrant statistically independent calibration errors. Reference separation means no stated value/coefficient input, not statistical or universal independence.
No exact latent physical maximum is warranted; corrected centers and reference maxima remain measured/nominal, with nonzero residual intervals.
Withheld reuse does not prove retained claim false; HOLD verifies false retained condition while UNRESOLVED leaves it unsupported.

external_truth.usage: External comparator only. UNRESOLVED abstains; unsupported lucky truth agreement earns no warrant.
